Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 10723 of 2024

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. & Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Anurag Pathak,Ashutosh Singh,Harshit Pathak,Neetu

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Pavan Kumar Mishra
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard Sri Anurag Pathak, learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 0174 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 504, 506 of I.P.C., Police Station- Thanabhawan, District- Shamli.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was named in the F.I.R. but the Investigating Officer has not submitted the charge sheet against the applicant.
He further submits that during trial, on the statement of opposite party no.2 on the application under Section 319 Cr.P.C., applicant has been summoned.

He further submits that applicant challenged the summoning order by way of Revision, which is pending before this Court and applicant has filed this Shabana vs State Of U.P. & Another on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27299864/
1

entities.text: Shabana vs State Of U.P. & Another on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail of the applicant stating that the revision is pending and he may raise his grievance before the revisional court.
5. Accordingly the relief as sought by the applicant through this application is refused.

6. Considering the aforesaid alternative prayer of the applicant, it is directed that if applicant surrenders before the concerned Court below within two weeks from today and applies for regular bail, the bail application shall be decided expeditiously by the courts below in accordance with law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922.
7.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For the period of two weeks from today or till the time of surrender of the applicant before the Court below, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against him.

8. With the aforesaid directions, this anticipatory bail application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 9.12.2024 Akram  Shabana vs State Of U.P. & Another on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27299864/
